hiddenObjects.name: Brass naval telescope
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A long brass barrel, balanced on its folding stand. Look for the worn collars and dark objective lens.

hiddenObjects.name: Enamel advertising sign
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. An oxblood enamel sign for the fictional Alden Railway. The lettering belongs to this world, not a real company.

hiddenObjects.name: Art Deco desk lamp
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. Geometric brass uprights carry the green shade: a small study in Art Deco symmetry.

hiddenObjects.name: 1930s mantel clock
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A walnut case and quiet ivory dial. The clock is a designed prop, not an authenticated period antique.

hiddenObjects.name: Carved wooden bird
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A little bird, carved in walnut tones, poised as if a sound has caught its attention.

hiddenObjects.name: Georgian writing box
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. Brass bands and a lock plate turn a portable writing box into a miniature piece of furniture.

hiddenObjects.name: Silver pocket watch
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A silver-coloured pocket watch with a curling chain. Imagine the pocket that might once have kept it warm.

hiddenObjects.name: Brass compass
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A needle, a dial and a brass rim: a small invitation to take a different route home.

hiddenObjects.name: Vintage folding camera
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. Leather bellows fold between the camera body and lens. Inspect it from the side to see how it opens.

hiddenObjects.name: Ceramic greyhound
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A long muzzle, slender legs and a curved tail distinguish this ceramic hound.

hiddenObjects.name: Miniature bronze bust
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A miniature bronze-coloured portrait bust on a dark plinth. Its sitter is fictional.

hiddenObjects.name: Ship in a bottle
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A tiny hull and canvas sails sit behind the glass: a whole imagined voyage on a shelf.

hiddenObjects.name: Mechanical music box
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A brass cylinder and delicate comb reveal the mechanism of this winding music box.

hiddenObjects.name: Old railway lantern
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. A railway lantern with a protective cage, arched handle and warm light.

hiddenObjects.name: Illustrated botanical book
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. Open pages carry an original botanical illustration made for this shop.

hiddenObjects.name: Small marquetry jewellery box
hiddenObjects.story: A fictional object from Gilt & Gather’s collection. Pale inlay and brass trim mark this little walnut-coloured jewellery box.
